scientific_target: Regional transfer of the fixed Lin–Catling modern-seawater calibration at the original six100m mean layers, compared on identical matched bottles with the original fixed depth-only pH means; no new calibration or causal attribution.

model.normalization: pmol/kg *1e-15 -> mol/g; PAAS ug/g *1e-6 /(molar_mass_mgmol *1e-3) -> mol/g; normalized four-element concentrations OLS against fixed atomic numbers, with intercept; pH=(alpha-model_intercept)/beta

bootstrap.scope: Conditional whole-station resampling only. Along-transect spatial dependence and non-probability sampling mean percentile intervals have no established nominal confidence coverage; analytical covariance and calibration parameter uncertainty are excluded.

systematic_scenarios.meaning: Observed offsets are conditional corrections motivated by two positive GP15 CRM offsets, not known sample corrections. Training-reference offsets shift both model and depth baseline identically. All crossed scenarios use identical primary support; no scenario is a confidence bound or truth.

estimands: Six matched-layer observed/predicted/depth-baseline pH means and errors
Unweighted-across-nonempty-fixed-layers bias, MAE and RMSE, always with coverage denominator
DeltaRMSE = fixed-model RMSE minus depth-baseline RMSE on identical layer support
Bottle-level residual distribution only secondary; no bottle-level p-value
stopping_and_interpretation: Stop before responses if input/source SHA or fixed model identity fails, or duplicate/ambiguous source identity cannot be resolved.
Preserve six layers even when empty or poorly supported; an entire200–800m domain statement requires all six layers to meet the prespecified station rule.

Give conditional station-resampling percentile intervals only with at least6 station labels and at least90% bootstrap draws covering all originally nonempty layers. Otherwise report point estimates/support only.
No scalar threshold makes the candidate paper-eligible. Evaluate magnitude against declared source-method scales and original training span without treating either as a universal acceptance bound.
If only an acknowledged generic caveat or a result driven by one station remains, close or narrow the claim rather than tune elements, coefficients, exclusions or bins.

Leg1 is exploration-exposed; Leg2 is a prospective response check only if root's exposure ledger verifies the freeze preceded response access. Shared cruise/lab precludes claiming independent-laboratory replication.
A regional transfer result cannot alone refute the original global-mean relation, the pH-complexation mechanism, or all paleo-carbonate applications.
input_contract: Source-bound input JSON: sources is a list with role,path,sha256 and optional columns; required roles leg1_ree,leg1_ph,leg2_ree,leg2_ph,paas,molar_mass,atomic_numbers,author_model_code,author_proxy_code,author_notebook,leg2_ree_intercal. All paths relative to input JSON or absolute. Root fills actual sources and freeze bindings.

leave_one_station_out.missing_original_nonempty_layer: Report missing support and suppress aggregate comparison; do not change denominator.

ree_repeatability_stress.source_locator: GP15 Leg2 REE intercalibration PDF8 Table2 andPDF9 Table3; maximum among listed reference-water RSDs for each of the four elements
ree_repeatability_stress.vectors: All16 combinations of +/-1 reported RSD; each element factor is common to all bottles within a case
ree_repeatability_stress.interpretation: Reference-repeatability-motivated conditional box only. Not measured sample-specific errors, a95%confidence interval, a full error covariance, or a conservative true bound. Common element shifts represent coherent systematic directions that do not diminish with sample count. All16vectors and all9pHscenarios are retained; no best-scenario selection. These are16 sampled corners only; there is no proof of extrema or uniform robustness over the continuous error box, especially for nonlinear model-minus-baseline RMSE.

blind_source_acquisition.locator: actual receipt and identity/flag/depth-only QA before freeze
